text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I was about to cross the field, I 
spotted Daitaku Helios and decided to call 
out to her.
choice_data_list: Fieldwork, huh? That's rare, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
A-Against the roster the Chairwoman 
assembled?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I have been entrusted with harvesting 
vegetables! Choosing an honor student like 
myself... the Chairwoman truly has an eye 
for talent!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Heliooos, Bakushin Ooo, got a minute~~?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
So about this vegetable... No matter how 
much I pull, it won't budge~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Leaves of an absurdly bizarre size were 
sticking out of the soil. They were so 
massive that I couldn't even begin to 
guess what kind of vegetable it was.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. It is my turn, then. Leave it to 
me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ready, and... Nghhhhhhh... !?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even with Sakura Bakushin O pulling with 
all her might, the leaf doesn't budge an 
inch. Daitaku Helios steps up next, but—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Bwahaha! Getting completely stuck is 
unreal! That's mega crazyyy~!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... No good, huh. Guess it's better to 
give up.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Give up, you say?! The only word in my 
dictionary is Bakushin! We are absolutely 
pulling it out!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Baku-chan, you always know just what to 
say! Alright! Let's get fired up!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: GET HYPED!! Whoooo~~! Ride the groove~~!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Chowaah!? What a delightful rhythm! This 
is... this is...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
My Bakushin spirit has been stirred...! 
Ohhhhh! I'm burning up with energyyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Baku-bakushin-shin, Bakushin-shiin! 
Bakushiiin... Bakushin!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah! Groove, nice!! Now let's br-i-n-g 
it~~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
There, there, there, there! 
BAKUSHIIIIIIIN...!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: "There, there, there, there! Aw yeaaaah!!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Everybody, come ooon! Hey, hey, heeeey!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hyped up by Daitaku Helios and Sakura 
Bakushin O, the other Umamusume all 
grabbed the veggies at once. And grooving 
to the rhythm, they pulled them right out!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Put your back into it, now all together♪ 
Forward, forward, BAKUSHIN BAKUSHIIIIIN!!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Fly away, check it, check it♪ Turn the 
hype up to the MAAAAX!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Bakushiiiiin! I'm so hyped uuuuup!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ms. Helios, let's pull our weight too!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Time for the finishing touch♪ Going from 
high energy straight to~~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Let's crank it all the way UP--!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With everyone's combined strength, we 
finally pulled the vegetable out. A 
massive, powerful root far larger than its 
leaves. It was on a scale I'd never seen 
before...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Chowaaa--?! This is an absolute monster of 
a catch!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Totally! It's crazy ginormous!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I mean, what kind of vegetable is this? 
I'm super curious now!
choice_data_list:
Let's hurry and have Chairwoman Akikawa 
take a look!

It might be a new species... Let's carry 
it out slowly and carefully

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: K! Going for maximum speed!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Splendid! That weed was far too massive to 
budge! My friends, well done pulling it 
up!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Bwahaha! Weeds, seriously?! That's 
hilarious! It's literally just grass, I'm 
dying~~~!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! For real~! Nobody asked for that 
kind of punchline~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone burst into laughter holding 
their sides at the completely unexpected 
outcome!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"This is totally gonna go viral, right?! 
Ok-dokey, let's carry it!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daitaku Helios took the lead in hauling 
out the vegetables. Just as everyone 
lifted them up, ready to head out...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Time to fire ourselves up with a bang! Put 
yo hands up! Yeaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Yaaay!
choice_data_list: W-Wait, if I raise my hand...!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ah... It dropped☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone raised their hands, causing the 
vegetable to drop. Though they lamented 
their mistake, it turned out to be just a 
common weed, ending in a good laugh!"
